Generators Australia's incorporation of ground-breaking technology in renewable products utilising Lithium and Solar provide value-based solutions across a wide range of Industries, including Construction, Rail, Civil Infrastructure and Mining.
We believe in creating a welcoming culture which is centered around our company values - People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement.
Our growth in Solar/Hybrid Lighting and Power products across Australia has continued to exceed expectations, so we are now looking for a qualified Electrician with some experience in working with solar to join our St Marys team.
This role is full-time and will be paying between $110,000.00 and $130,000.00 per annum.
Other responsibilities will include:
•	Maintaining our Hybrid, Solar and Diesel-Powered assets
•	Test and Tagging of all equipment and other assets
•	Minor electrical Installations
•	Overall technical electrical support
•	Responsible for performing scheduled and breakdown electrical and mechanical maintenance on our fleet of equipment.
•	Diagnosing and rectifying electrical issues on all assets
•	Where required, undertake mechanical maintenance and repairs
•	Maintaining a strong safety focus.
•	Hours will be 7am to 5pm. Monday to Friday.
The successful candidate will be an individual who will honour our core value of People, Safety, Respect, Communication and Continuous Improvement - in addition to this they will have:
•	Qualified Electrician with a recognised electrical trade qualification and the ability to obtain the required Australian electrical licence.
•	Valid Driver's License.
•	Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Tradesperson.
•	Ability to carry out basic electrical fault diagnosis and rectification.
•	Experience in electrical installation and commissioning, servicing, periodical inspections, preventative maintenance, and repairs to Generators Australia's equipment to meet both manufacture and company standards.
•	Experience working with Batteries, Inverters, Solar systems, EV Chargers and Diesel Engines
•	Ability to travel to East coast branches to provide overall technical support when required
•	Strong communication skills.
The Benefits of Joining Generators Australia
•	A competitive remuneration package aligned with your experience and qualifications.
•	Fully maintained company vehicle, fuel card, laptop and mobile phone.
•	The opportunity to work for a well-established and secure organisation.
•	On-going training and development
•	Inspirational leadership that is eager to help you succeed.
•	Employee Reward & Recognition programs to celebrate your successes.
•	Company Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support mental health.
•	A positive workplace with an ongoing commitment to continuous improvement and development
•	A safe workplace with a strong focus on ZERO harm - Every day
How to Apply
This is a great opportunity to work in a progressive and dynamic team within a secure and stable industry. If you feel that you have the experience, ability, and skills, we want to hear from you!
Click "Apply Now" and upload an updated copy of your resume and cover letter.
At Generators Australia, we recognize that we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and encourage women and Indigenous candidates to apply.

About AMA

The AMA Group, is Australia's largest network of accident repair facilities, which currently comprises of over 120 outlets and over 2,200 employees across Australia and New Zealand.

The AMA Group's success is a result of our commitment of providing our clients and work providers with quality and cost-effective repairs, as well as exceptional customer service. Our people is what makes this possible and are therefore our focus. We invest in our people. Creating the leaders of today and developing the skills for tomorrow.

 

About Capital S.M.A.R.T

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs is the industry leader of the collision repair industry, specialising in small, medium, and larger repairs. We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions.

About the Role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Insurance Loss Adjustor to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition. This is a full-time position located in all areas of Regional QLD.

The primary purpose of this role is to be responsible for the timely completion of accurate and comprehensive quotes for accident repairs on vehicles. You will apply your knowledge of motor vehicles and your skills with computers whilst interacting with a range of people. 

Reporting to the Centre Manager this role will work within our large network of repair facilities and you will be provided with stability and opportunity.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing excellent customer service to clients and work providers
- Accurately quote vehicles in a timely manner and in accordance with average repair cost targets and insurer/company procedures
- Complete quotes as required onsite, off-site and online
- Processing vehicles onsite by carrying out vehicle arrival inspections, including mapping and imaging
- Manage parts for repairs to ensure timely arrival and cost effectiveness as required
- Manage suppliers to ensure additional work is recorded and authorised in a timely manner
- Assist with production management of the centre where required
- Ensure vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition
- Hand over completed repairs to customers

About You
- Proven experience within a similar position including experience in the preparation of estimates / quotations in the automotive smash repair industry
- Proven experience with AudaNet would be highly desirable
- Ibody experience desirable but not necessary
- Excellent customer service skills including building rapport with customers and work providers
- Highly professional and personable
- Strong systems experience and competent computer abilities
- Excel an advantage but not a necessary
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Ability to meet strict deadlines
- Ability to problem solve and excellent accuracy and attention to detail
- Able to work effectively and collaboratively with the team
- Strong commitment to work in a safe manner
- High attention to detail
- Be reliable, punctual & hardworking

We are leaders in the repair industry and offer
-Team environment
-Ongoing training
-Career opportunity
-Latest tools, equipment and process
-Great opportunity to earn big $$$ for competent and efficient tradespeople
-Junior-Mid experienced tradesperson $60-$80k
-Mid-Senior tradesperson $80k-$100k
-Annual salary 

If you are hardworking, motivated and seeking a career a with an industry leader please apply online.

All applications will be treated in strictest confidence.
